answer: Make most rewards vest slowly: new earnings stay locked for many epochs and unlock only while the account keeps answering and grading well. A sybil farm then has to keep every fake identity working like an orchard tended season after season before any fruit can be picked, so spinning up a thousand accounts buys little. Unlock events act as a public beacon too: if dozens of accounts all drain to one wharf address the moment they vest, that pattern is easy for graders to flag.
